jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Power Solutions, we're strengthening the cost competitiveness of our Connect & Control Solutions (CCS) portfolio to support future growth and profitability. As our new Sourcing Project Manager, Pipeline, based in Nordborg, Denmark, you'll play a key role in that journey.

Working across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance, you'll identify and drive cost optimization initiatives that improve product competitiveness and create lasting value for our customers. You'll help advance our design-to-cost approach and deliver sustainable cost improvements across a global product portfolio.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions, collaborate with stakeholders across a global matrix organization, and turn ideas into measurable business results.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead pipeline generation of cross-functional cost optimization projects that improve product competitiveness and deliver measurable business value

• Identify and prioritize cost reduction opportunities through data-driven analysis and collaboration to build a strong pipeline of impactful initiatives.

• Facilitate workshops and improvement activities that generate ideas, align stakeholders, and accelerate implementation

• Influence and align stakeholders across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance to secure commitment and successfully deliver results

• Strengthen cost management processes, tools, and governance to improve consistency, transparency, and long-term effectiveness.

What We're Looking For

• Strong project management experience with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business results

• An engineering background, preferably within electronics, or a strong technical understanding of products, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers

• Experience with cost reduction, sourcing/procurement, engineering, or a combination of these areas, including identifying and implementing improvement opportunities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, build strong partnerships, and navigate a complex global matrix organization

• A growth mindset and passion for continuous improvement, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, creativity, and the ability to balance detailed analysis with broader business goals

What You'll Get from Us

This is a high-impact role within Danfoss Power Solutions, where you'll help shape the future cost competitiveness of our CCS portfolio.

Furthermore:

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Travel: Approximately 30 days per year

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're excited about driving cost optimization, collaborating across functions, and turning opportunities into measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience, perspective, and problem-solving mindset could be exactly what we're looking for.

Our Commitment to Transparency

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

The Impact You'll Make

**

Do you thrive in a role where strategic thinking and hands-on execution go hand in hand?**

As our Specialist, Strategic Procurement & Quality at Danfoss IXA, you'll play a critical role in securing the supplier partnerships, materials, and commercial agreements that support our products and future growth.

Your work will help secure material availability, strong supplier performance, and competitive cost levels, ensuring the business can meet both customer expectations and future growth ambitions.

Working in a small and agile organization, you'll have a visible impact across the business. Success in this role comes from combining a strategic mindset with a collaborative approach, building trusted relationships internally and externally, and helping create a supply chain that is resilient, efficient, and ready to support future growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Develop and manage the supplier base, balancing cost, quality, delivery performance, inventory, and supply risk.

• Lead supplier selection, sourcing activities, commercial negotiations, contracting, onboarding, and ongoing supplier quality performance management.

• Drive cost improvements and strengthen supply continuity through structured risk management, inventory strategies, and mitigation plans.

• Partner with colleagues across R&D, Quality, Operations, Planning, Finance, Sales, and Business Development to support projects and secure material availability.

• Combine strategic purchasing responsibilities with hands-on operational purchasing activities, helping resolve supply chain challenges and secure uninterrupted business operations.

• Improve stock management, increase transparency, and drive productivity improvements to support business performance.

You will also serve as a key user and go-to person for our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud system, supporting the team and contributing to reliable material data and processes.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within strategic purchasing, sourcing, procurement, or supply chain in a manufacturing, engineering, or technical environment.

• Proven ability to negotiate with suppliers and manage commercial agreements while balancing cost, quality, delivery performance, and supply risk.

• Experience working with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, and using ERP systems to support purchasing, material planning, and supply chain processes.

• A practical and hands-on approach, with the flexibility to move between strategic initiatives and operational priorities when business needs require it.

• Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a team-oriented mindset and a willingness to support colleagues across functions.

We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, follows challenges through to resolution, and thrives in a small and agile organization where teamwork, flexibility, and a broad business perspective are essential to success.

What You'll Get from Us

• You’ll have significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence supplier relationships, procurement practices, and supply chain performance in a small organization.

• You'll work closely with decision-makers and colleagues across several functions while benefiting from the knowledge, network, and career opportunities of the wider Danfoss organization.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about - we think they’re pretty great.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. #LI-KJ1

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

jobs.occupation: B2B Sales Development Representative – SaaS | Galten (near Aarhus)
jobs.description:
**🟢 About Mapon

**35,000+ active clients. More than 400,000 connected devices. 150+ partners worldwide. And 200+ colleagues behind it all. Mapon has already built the scale, trust and reach of an established European B2B SaaS and telematics company, and we are still far from finished. Our platform helps businesses manage their vehicles, teams and assets, reduce costs, improve safety, simplify compliance and make smarter decisions. It delivers real value at scale and keeps evolving with the businesses that rely on it.

Those 200+ colleagues work across eight Mapon branches: Latvia, Spain, Estonia, Finland, Denmark, Lithuania, Sweden and Ireland, with our headquarters in Riga, Latvia. Our team reaches beyond those eight branches, bringing together people from even more countries. That mix of local market knowledge, international experience and different perspectives helps us grow one shared product across markets worldwide.

**✅ Why Join Mapon?

**Behind those numbers is a product that never stops improving and a team that keeps moving it forward. That gives Mapon a strong foundation for the next stage of growth: deeper relationships in the markets where we are already present, more businesses to reach and new opportunities to unlock. For Sales, it means a credible story to take to customers, backed by a platform that delivers real value and plenty of potential ahead.

**🇩🇰Working at Mapon Denmark

**At the Mapon Danish branch, you’ll join a local team of 9 colleagues, including 3 people in Sales team. You’ll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It’s the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

**💻 Role Description

**As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our future customers. You’ll reach out to companies across different industries to introduce Mapon’s fleet management and asset-tracking solutions. Your mission: generate high-quality leads, book meetings with potential clients, and support the Growth and Sales teams in growing our presence in the Danish market.

A typical week will include researching and identifying potential customers, reaching out through calls, emails and LinkedIn, following up on conversations and building new sales opportunities, giving you plenty of room to sharpen your B2B sales skills and take ownership of your results.

**🚀How Your Onboarding Will Look Like

**Your first months at Mapon will be about getting to know our customers, our product, and what makes a great sales conversation, with regular feedback and support from the team. You’ll connect with businesses facing real, everyday fleet challenges and introduce solutions that can make a meaningful difference to their operations. It’s a chance to strengthen your B2B sales skills, take ownership of your results, and grow your career with an established international SaaS company.

**💼 What You’ll Do

**

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities in the Danish market

• Reach out to potential clients via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn

• Qualify leads through discovery conversations

• Schedule and book meetings with potential clients for our Sales Manager

• Collaborate with the Growth team to refine messaging and outreach strategies

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve sales approaches and product positioning

• Maintain accurate CRM records and report activities

**✅ What We’re Looking For

**

• Native level Danish and excellent communication skills in English (spoken & written)

• At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer-facing roles (ideally B2B SaaS, but not mandatory)

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented mindset

• Curious and coachable — you’re eager to learn, take feedback well, and want to grow in sales

• Resilient — you’re not afraid of rejection and know how to bounce back with energy

• Tech-savvy and eager to learn new tools (CRM, sales engagement platforms, etc.)

**🌍 Why Mapon?

**💰 Base salary from 27 000 DKK/ Gross (monthly) **+ OTE bonus based on performance

**🌍 Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

🍕 Partly subsided lunch at the office.

🧘♀️ Hybrid work setup – work from home or in a cozy office in Galten (mainly work is organized from the office).

🤖 Access to AI tools and paid plans, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others if needed, to support your daily work and productivity.

🎉 Social events, team buildings, and a supportive work culture.

💼 Laptop, accessories, and everything you need.

🎂 Extra day off on your birthday.

🧠 Annual training budget.

🕓 Flexible hours to enjoy life outside work.

🪴 Wellness days- take time off when you’re not feeling well, without the need for a sick leave certificate;

🤝 Referral bonus — receive a reward when you refer a candidate who successfully joins our team;

🎓 Mentor bonus — onboarding mentors receive an additional salary bonus when their new colleague reaches the two-month milestone;

👥Join a friendly, supportive team where you'll thrive, with a well-planned onboarding process starting from day one to ensure your success.

**⏰ Our Hiring Process

**

• 
CV review – Your application will be reviewed by HR and the Hiring Manager (Head of SDR).

• 
Pre-recorded interview (Testlify) – Selected candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded interview via Testlify (in video format)to answer questions and test language knowledge, allowing you to answer at a time that suits you best.

• 
Video interview – interview with HR and Hiring Manager (up to 60min).

• 
Video interview – Final interview with the Sales Team Lead of the Denmark branch (up to 60min).

• 
Background check - references.

This is your chance to be part of something meaningful, grow your skills, and make your mark in a dynamic and future-focused company. Apply now and let’s shape the future of telematics – together.

• We provide detailed feedback on interview performance and/or the technical task only to candidates who have reached the final stage of the selection process.

**🧭 Ready to join the adventure? Send us your Resume in English today! 🚀

**Mapon Denmark ApS (Reg. no. 38434640)

**Are you an experienced HR Business Partner who thrives in a global environment where People & Culture is a strategic business partner rather than a support function?

**At Palsgaard, we are strengthening our global People & Culture platform to support our continued growth and long-term ambitions. We are looking for an experienced Senior Global People Partner who can partner with senior leaders and help build the organizational capabilities needed for the future.

Palsgaard is a global company owned by the Schou Foundation. Our foundation ownership gives us a long-term perspective and the freedom to invest in our people, innovation, and sustainable growth. We believe that responsible leadership, strong relationships, and engaged employees are the foundation of lasting business success.

You will join us at an exciting point in our journey, where you will have the opportunity to influence how leadership, organizational effectiveness, reward, talent, and people processes continue to evolve across our global organization.

This is an opportunity for an experienced People Partner who combines strong people expertise with a genuine understanding of business and enjoys translating business strategy into organizational capability and people initiatives.

You will become part of our Global People & Culture team and work closely with members of our Executive Leadership Team, senior leaders across our global organization, and local People & Culture colleagues.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted partnerships with senior leaders, acting as a strategic advisor on organizational effectiveness, leadership, and people-related business decisions.

• Drive and continuously strengthen global people processes including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.

• Partner with leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and change initiatives that support business priorities.

• Advise leaders on reward-related topics including job architecture, salary reviews, career frameworks, and organizational structures.

• Lead and facilitate organizational development projects across functions and geographies.

• Support leaders in managing complex employee relations cases while balancing business needs with our company values.

• Ensure our global People & Culture initiatives are successfully translated into practical solutions that create value locally.

**What You Bring

**We are looking for a strong Global People Partner who combines solid HR expertise with business understanding.

You will likely have:

• Extensive experience as a People Partner in an international organization, where structured Global People processes are an integrated part of how the business Operates.

• Proven experience working with structured HR disciplines such as performance management, talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and organizational development.

• Strong Experience working with compensation, salary review processes, job architecture, or global reward frameworks.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business priorities into effective people practices and organizational solutions.

• Experience in coaching and influencing senior leaders and leadership teams.

• A structured, analytical approach and confidence using people data to support decision-making.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in both written and spoken English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

**What We Offer

**

• A strategic People & Culture role with significant influence across our global business.

• The opportunity to shape and continuously develop our global people agenda.

• A collaborative and highly professional People & Culture team.

• Attractive employment conditions including an additional week of vacation, health insurance, and profit-sharing through our pension scheme.

• A strong company culture built on trust, collaboration, and long-term thinking.

• An international environment with colleagues and leaders across the world.

• A collaborative and informal working environment at our global headquarters in Juelsminde, surrounded by the unique natural setting of the historic Palsgaard Estate.

**Are You Our New Colleague?

**If you are motivated by partnering with leaders, driving organizational performance, and making professional HR processes create real business value, we would love to hear from you.

As we are entering the summer holiday period, there may be a little longer response time than usual. We will review incoming applications on an ongoing basis and expect to conduct first-round interviews during weeks 34 and 35.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Global People Partner Director Lars Flensborg at +45 40 58 93 73. I will be available for conversations about the role during weeks 28 and 29.

jobs.occupation: Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by connecting people, data, technology and business? Can you turn complex workforce topics into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders? And do you combine strategic perspective with the structure and drive required to make things happen in practice?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our new Head of People Insights, HR Technology & Rewards, you will lead and develop three closely connected areas: maturing People Insights, driving the HR Technology agenda, including Oracle HCM and the global technology roadmap, and providing governance and executive decision support within Rewards in close collaboration with our Rewards Partner.

Leading a small specialist team, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, personally driving key initiatives, analyses and decision support while working with senior leaders across the business to turn data, technology and governance into clear recommendations and business impact.

More specifically, you will be:

• Building and maturing our People Insights capability through workforce KPIs, executive dashboards and forward-looking insights that support better workforce and organisational decision-making.

• Owning the HR technology landscape and roadmap, acting as senior P&C business owner for Oracle HCM and ensuring systems, data and global processes deliver business value and a strong user experience.

• Leading governance of the global rewards agenda, ensuring effective annual processes, clear decision support and strong collaboration across the business.

• Establishing robust people data and portfolio governance, ensuring clear ownership, data quality, privacy, compliance and effective prioritisation of initiatives, risks and resources.

• Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a small team, setting direction while driving delivery and results.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and evolving agenda, where you can help strengthen the way data, technology and rewards support both leaders and business decisions across Kamstrup.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting directly to the CHRO and being part of the P&C Leadership Team, you will lead a newly established team of three specialists responsible for Global Rewards, Reporting & Master Data and People Systems.

The team plays a crucial role in delivering trusted people data, supporting global reward processes, driving HR systems development and enabling workforce insights across the organization. Together, you will create a stronger governance foundation while continuously improving how People & Culture supports leaders and business performance.

**Less About Us, More About You

**You may come from People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy, Rewards or HR Transformation. More important than deep expertise across all areas is your ability to lead across disciplines, create structure and turn data, technology and rewards into better business decisions. You likely bring strong experience in People Insights or HR Technology, alongside sufficient rewards and governance expertise to lead the agenda credibly with support from specialists.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Bring experience from a global organisation, ideally within People Insights, HR Technology, Workforce Strategy or HR Transformation.

• Have strong analytical capabilities, including workforce metrics, data visualisation and translating insights into business recommendations.

• Have experience with enterprise HR platforms and transformations, preferably Oracle HCM or a similar cloud-based HCM solution.

• Understand rewards governance, compensation cycles and executive decision processes, enabling effective leadership of the agenda alongside specialists.

• Communicate confidently with senior leaders and provide clear decision support in English.

Success in the role will be reflected in stronger people insights, successful Oracle adoption, improved data quality and rewards processes, and a clear HR technology roadmap, with People & Culture recognised as a trusted, data-driven partner in strategic workforce decision-making.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Vice President - Chief People & Culture Officer, Sofie Mørch Ravn, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation is a strategic transformation role responsible for strengthening People Operations and Payroll through improved data governance, process effectiveness, operational controls, reporting, systems enablement and automation. The role is not accountable for day-to-day operational execution; instead, it focuses on designing, improving and implementing sustainable, scalable and efficient ways of working across People Operations and Payroll.

The role owns the continuous improvement of People Experience across key operational touchpoints, including preboarding, offboarding, leave management, query management, employee lifecycle administration and employee and manager satisfaction measurement. While the role remains closely connected to operational realities, this is through data, insights, stakeholder feedback and process review rather than direct operational delivery.

As the primary subject matter expert for People Operations and Payroll data quality, operational controls, systems enablement and transformation initiatives, the Specialist is accountable for strengthening data integrity, applying a Six Sigma approach to measuring process effectiveness, establishing sustainable controls, improving operational reporting and driving automation. This includes supporting the implementation of ServiceNow HRSD, introducing automated workflows and working closely with GBS to identify opportunities for robots and automation that reduce manual effort and improve service consistency.

The role works closely with GO People Operations, Payroll, GBS, People Experience, Employee Relations, and other relevant stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable processes, technology enhancements, automated workflows and more efficient ways of working. The role also brings external insight into People Operations and Payroll by identifying best practice, latest research and inspiration from other organisations to continuously improve the employee and manager experience.

Strategic Accountabilities

• Service design and operating model: Define and improve scalable People Operations and Payroll processes, service standards, ownership models, hand-offs and escalation routes in line with the One Team model and the future tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Data governance and controls: Establish governance standards, control requirements, reconciliation principles and audit-ready evidence standards across People Operations and Payroll.

• Systems and HRSD enablement: Own strategic requirements for SuccessFactors and ServiceNow HRSD, translating business needs into process design, workflow requirements, system enhancements, testing, training and adoption plans.

• Automation and robotics: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, variation and repetitive work through automated workflows, robotics and close collaboration with GBS.

• Insights and continuous improvement: Use KPIs, process measures, satisfaction data, stakeholder feedback, external best practice and latest research to identify priorities and drive sustained improvement.

• Change and implementation: Lead structured implementation of transformation initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, change planning, adoption and handover into business ownership.

Key Success Measures

• Improved data accuracy, control effectiveness and audit readiness across People Operations and Payroll.

• Reduced manual effort, errors, rework and process variation through automation, robotics and improved workflows.

• Successful implementation and adoption of ServiceNow HRSD and the tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Clearer service ownership, escalation routes, standards and hand-offs across People Operations, Payroll and relevant People Experience touchpoints.

• Improved employee and manager satisfaction through simpler, more consistent and insight-led service delivery.

• Use of a Six Sigma-inspired measurement approach to define baselines, track errors and rework, identify root causes and evidence sustained process improvement.

• Delivery of agreed transformation milestones with sustainable handover into business ownership.

Fit within the One Team People Operations Model

• Employees and managers are supported collectively by the operational People Operations and Payroll teams, rather than through dedicated Business Unit alignment.

• The wider People Operations role design preserves the One Team model while creating clearer specialist ownership and protected capacity for agreed focus areas.

• Operational specialists and associate specialists deliver day-to-day employee and manager services; this role complements them by creating the conditions for those services to become more scalable, automated, data-led and consistent.

• This role strengthens the foundations that enable consistent service delivery, including standards, governance, controls, reporting, automation, systems, HRSD enablement and service design.

• Day-to-day operational execution remains with the relevant operational teams; this role focuses on strategic improvement, implementation and enablement.

• Transformation priorities are informed by operational insight from operational teams, Payroll, Employee Relations, People Experience, GBS and People Experience & Services, but remain focused on scalable, future-ready solutions rather than live case delivery.

Fit within the Wider People Experience Team

The Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation also plays an important enabling role across the wider People Experience team. While the role is anchored in People Operations and Payroll transformation, its impact extends across People Experience, Employee Relations and Talent Acquisition because these areas are connected through shared employee and manager journeys, service touchpoints, data, systems and process hand-offs.

Within the wider People Experience team, this role helps turn strategic priorities into practical, scalable service improvements. It supports a more joined-up employee and manager experience by identifying where processes, technology, automation, knowledge, controls and service standards need to be better connected across the full employee lifecycle — from attraction and hiring through preboarding, employment, employee relations matters, leave management, query resolution and offboarding.

• People Operations and Payroll: strengthens the core service delivery model through data governance, automation, HRSD implementation, controls, reporting and process effectiveness.

• People Experience: ensures operational touchpoints are designed around a simple, consistent and positive employee and manager experience, using satisfaction data, best practice and external insights to inform improvements.

• Employee Relations: works closely with the Manager, Employee Relations to ensure processes, hand-offs, documentation, escalation routes and service standards support compliant, consistent and sensitive handling of employee matters.

• Talent Acquisition: connects hiring, preboarding and onboarding touchpoints so candidates, new joiners, hiring managers and People teams experience a clear, consistent and well-managed transition into employment.

In this way, the role acts as a strategic connector across the wider People Experience team. It does not own the functional agendas of People Experience, Employee Relations or Talent Acquisition, but it helps ensure that the processes, systems, data, automation and service design behind those agendas are joined up, measurable and scalable. This makes the role critical to building a more consistent, insight-led and future-ready employee and manager experience across the organisation.

Why Pandora?

This is your opportunity to join a global brand at a transformative moment. You’ll work with passionate colleagues, senior leaders, and cross-functional teams to shape the future of cost management at Pandora—making a real impact on our ability to grow and thrive.

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

jobs.occupation: Re-advertisement: Decipher Complex Phenotypes via Cross-species Analysis of the Regulatory Genome
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Center for Kvantitativ Geneti
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Re-advertisement: Decipher Complex Phenotypes via Cross-species Analysis of the Regulatory Genome

Research area and project description
A fundamental challenge in modern genetics is decoding how non-coding genetic variation regulates gene expression to shape complex phenotypes. Despite the wealth of GWAS data, the lack of functional insights remains a significant barrier to the advancement of genomic selection in precision agriculture and the implementation of personalized medicine in humans.

Objectives This PhD project seeks to revolutionize our understanding of regulatory logic by:

1. Developing Novel AI Frameworks: Building state-of-the-art computational models to identify functional genetic variants that govern gene regulation across diverse species, including farmed animals and humans.

2. Cross-Species Comparative Analysis: Investigating the evolutionary conservation and divergence of gene regulatory patterns between farmed animals and humans.

3. Mapping the Genetic Landscape: Elucidating how these regulatory mechanisms orchestrate the architecture of complex traits to improve predictive accuracy in both clinical and agricultural settings.

Research Environment The successful candidate will join a high-impact international research group with a track record of publishing in premier journals such as Nature Genetics and Cell Genomics. You will leverage large-scale multi-omics datasets to bridge the gap between DNA sequence and function.

Below are several relevant publications:

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-025-02121-5
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-023-01585-7
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-025-02155-9;
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-025-02329-5
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-025-02329-5
https://www.cell.com/cell-genomics/fulltext/S2666-979X(23)00187-8

Project description: For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Qualifications and specific competences:
The successful candidate must hold a master’s degree in Statistical Genetics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative field.

Technical & Professional Competencies:

• 
Computational Proficiency: Advanced programming skills in Python or R are essential for developing and implementing genomic algorithms.

• 
Analytical Expertise: Prior experience with machine learning or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) is highly desirable, particularly in the context of sequence-to-function modeling.

• 
Scientific Drive: A strong intellectual interest in human/animal genetics or comparative genomics, with a desire to decode the regulatory logic of complex traits.

• 
Communication Excellence: Proficiency in written and spoken English is required, as the role involves drafting high-impact manuscripts and collaborating across international research consortia.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, bld. 1130, 8000, Aarhus, Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• 
Lingzhao Fang, lingzhao.fang@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)

• 
Goutam Sahana, goutam.sahana@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)

• 
Peter Sørensen, pso@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

Your Qualifications

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

• 
Have several years of experience from a similar position

• 
Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

• 
Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

• 
Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

• 
Work in a structured and independent manner

• 
Are reliable, flexible and responsible

• 
Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

The position is available as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right candidate.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Dan Andersen on +45 28 45 80 35.

Are you ready for your next step? Submit your application via this link: 
https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=1035&ProjectId=146122&DepartmentId=18964&MediaId=5

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Ship Hull Fitters // Ship Plate Fitters //Platers Wanted
jobs.description:
We are looking for:

• 
Ship Hull Fitters // Ship Plate Fitters //Platers 

for marine industry in Denmark

Scan Con offers jobs at the Shipyards on Reparation and New Build Departments. 

Key tasks:

• 
Assemble and install ship hull sections according to blueprints and specifications

• 
Align and secure structural parts to ensure a proper fit

• 
Cut, shape, and prepare metal components for assembly

• 
Perform welding, bolting, and riveting tasks as required

• 
Locates and marks reference lines; such as center, buttock, and frame lines

• 
Positions parts in hull of a Ship, assisted by rigger

• 
Aligns parts relation to each other using jacks, lever blocks, chain blocks, clips, wedges, etc.

• 
Marks location of holes to be drilled and installs temporary fasteners to hold parts in a place for welding or revising

• 
Install packing, gasket, liner, and structural accessories and members such as doors, hatches, brackets, and clips

• 
Tack and weld clips and brackets in place prior to permanent welding

• 
May prepare molds and templates for fabrication of non-standard parts

• 
May roll, bend flange, cut and shape plates, beams, and other heavy metal parts using shop machinery; such as plate roll, presses, bending  brakes, and joggle machine

• 
Performs other duties as required

Skills:

• 
English - must be able to communicate in English 

• 
Always attentive to detail and alert to ensure safety

• 
Ability to receive and follow instructions and communicate with co-workers

• 
Ability to read labels, safety warnings, and guidelines

Experience:

• 
Experience is good to have but that's not necessary

We Offer you:

·         Full time job in Denmark 

·         Danish contract signed with Scan Con Construction, work for Scan Con Construction

·         Attractive salary (also vacation money, Free Choice Account, Labor market pension)

·         We guarantee 37 hours per week with possibilities for overtime (The normal average weekly working hours are according to the Union agreement as well as any local agreements)

·         Flight tickets

·         Transport to/ from job 

·         Accommodation 

·         Safety courses

·         Work tools and clothes

·         Help with applying for a residence and work permit after the Fast track scheme

·         Health insurance / Medical help

INTERESTED?

If you have any questions about the position, or if you wish to apply, you are welcome to contact Magda Kosecka HR Administrator on phone: +45 32 82 00 00 or send your application to cv@scan-con.dk – in e-mail title please write Ship Hull Fitters // Ship Plate Fitters //Platers

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.
